recentItems.title: Asmat Omu New Guinea Part 2 of 2
recentItems.description: Part 2 of 2.  This video shows the carving of an Asmat omu that was recorded by two members of the L. D. Holmes Museum of Anthropology, Jerry Martin and Troy Belford.  The Holmes Museum of Anthropology is part of Wichita State University, Wichita, KS.  The museum's website is www.holmes.anthropology.museum.

recentItems.title: Asmat drum new guinea (Part 2 of 2)
recentItems.description: Part 2.  During the summer of 2007 two members of the Holmes Museum of Anthropology traveled to the Asmat region of New Guinea.  There they filmed a video of an Asmat man named Robbie carving an Asmat drum.

recentItems.title: Asmat Drum New Guinea (Part 1 of 2)
recentItems.description: In the summer of 2007 two members of the Holmes Museum of Anthropology at Wichita State University traveled to the Asmat region of New Guinea.  They recorded the making of a drum by an Asmat man named Robbie.

recentItems.title: Korowai Shield New Guinea
recentItems.description: In the summer of 2007 two members of the Holmes Museum of Anthropology at Wichita State University traveled to the Korowai area of New Guinea Island and filmed the process of making a Korowai shield.

recentItems.title: Lives of Our Ancestors Asmat Bis Ceremony New Guinea (Part 3 of 4)
recentItems.description: Part 3.  In the summer of 2007 two members of the Holmes Museum of Anthropology at Wichita State University traveled to the Asmat area of New Guinea.  This video documents the preparation and performance of a bis ceremony.
